_description: A region producer (OIP 0.3 draft). graph-tracer does not ingest sources. It consumes an existing 'chart' region another producer wrote (a chart image with a png crop) and derives a 'chart_series' region carrying the digitized data. The derived region keeps the parent's source_ref, so a recovered pump curve still points at the page and bbox it came from. Renders as a 'chart'.

source_ref_handlers.pdf-page-bbox: open the PDF at page and highlight bbox

agent.skill:
## graph-tracer — digitize a chart region

Use this when a region is a plotted chart (a pump curve, an efficiency map) and you want the real series, not just the image. Supply two calibration ticks per axis and a few waypoints per line, in pixels; the tool returns the data.

### Tools
- `graphtracer.trace_chart(slug, region_id, x_ticks, y_ticks, lines, params)` — derive a chart_series region from a chart region.

### Typical situation
A datasheet was ingested by a PDF producer. One region is `kind: chart` with a png crop. Read the crop, read the axes and tick values, place sparse waypoints on each line, and call trace_chart. The derived region keeps the chart's page and bbox.
